recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not revert the FHIR-41607 mapping without a new PA decision; any remaining v2-to-FHIR IG mapping changes should be handled in that IG or a separate issue.
issue_request: FHIR-13861 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request asking for ARQ-7 and SCH-7 to map to Appointment.appointmentType, not Appointment.reason, and for ARQ-8 and SCH-8 to map to Appointment.serviceType.
initial_application: Historical commit 7b08cd473fbd0b8f8834494c9545fb1c7f1ac565 applied FHIR-13861 by adding ARQ-8/SCH-8 to Appointment.serviceType, changing Appointment.appointmentType from ARQ-7 to ARQ-7/SCH-7, and removing SCH-7 from Appointment.reason.
additional_context: FHIR-41607 is a later Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification PA decision on the same Appointment v2 mapping confusion. After PA and InM review of v2 user-defined tables 0276 and 0277 and real-world mapping practice, it removed the core Appointment.appointmentType ARQ-7/SCH-7 mapping and updated Appointment.serviceType to ARQ-8/SCH-8 or ARQ-7/SCH-7 with a trading-partner review note. The combined branch source matches that later decision.
reconciliation: An empty audit commit was published. Re-adding the FHIR-13861 appointmentType mapping would conflict with the later FHIR-41607 decision; current source still avoids mapping SCH-7/ARQ-7 to Appointment.reason and instead captures the current serviceType guidance.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied PA decision deliberately replaced the FHIR-13861 appointmentType mapping with broader serviceType guidance for ARQ/SCH-7 and ARQ/SCH-8.
